task: In the Halcyon Studio billing sandbox, raise the August 2026 invoice for the client whose company name is 'Northwind Atlas Ltd'. Look the client up by name to get its client id, then read its contract terms for the contracted hourly rate and the billable hours already logged for August 2026, and read the tax rate that applies to the client's tax region. Compute the invoice as follows, in this order: subtotal = billable hours x contracted hourly rate, rounded to 2 decimals; tax = subtotal x tax rate, rounded to 2 decimals; total = subtotal + tax, rounded to 2 decimals. Create the draft invoice with those three exact figures, then issue the draft so it becomes a final numbered invoice. Report the final invoice number and the total amount due.

tools.name: find_client
tools.description: Look up a client by exact company name. Returns client_id and tax_region.

tools.name: get_contract_terms
tools.description: Return a client's contract terms: contracted hourly rate and the billable hours logged for August 2026.

tools.name: get_tax_rate
tools.description: Return the tax rate that applies to a tax region.

tools.name: create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Create a draft invoice for a client. subtotal_usd, tax_usd and total_usd must each be exact to 2 decimals and internally consistent with the contract and the region's tax rate. Returns a draft_id.

require.error: Only the 2026-08 billing period is open.
Rejected: subtotal_usd does not equal billable hours multiplied by the contracted hourly rate.
Rejected: tax_usd does not equal the subtotal multiplied by the region's tax rate, rounded to 2 decimals.
Rejected: total_usd does not equal subtotal plus tax, rounded to 2 decimals.

tools.name: issue_invoice
tools.description: Issue a draft invoice so it becomes final and numbered. Requires the draft_id from create_invoice_draft. Returns the final invoice number.

require.error: No such draft: create the invoice draft first.

tools.name: list_open_invoices
tools.description: List invoices that are still unpaid across all clients.

tools.name: send_payment_reminder
tools.description: Email a payment reminder for an existing invoice.

tools.name: get_currency_conversion
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies at today's rate.
tools.distractor_reply: Conversion returned. (This invoice is billed in USD only.)
